spec.headline: Integrated B2B Marketing | Sales Collaboration | Campaign Performance
spec.headline_rationale: AHEAD's field role needs cross-functional regional execution, sales coordination, budgets and ROI. Use verified B2B leadership, multi-market teams and client strategy without inventing field events, partner activations or ABM pipeline history.
spec.summary: B2B and digital marketer experienced in coordinating teams, campaigns and performance reporting around business priorities. Directed marketing and e-commerce across sales, product, IT, finance and operations, and led an eight-person team serving U.S., Canadian and U.K. markets. Agency consulting spans client goals, audience research, channel planning and budget allocation. Content strategy, campaign testing and leadership KPI reporting support practical collaboration, clear recommendations and disciplined use of marketing resources across varied stakeholders and markets.
spec.factual_review: Read exact AHEAD Field Marketing Manager Central Region description including up-to40%travel. E060/E093/E076/E078/E114/E095/E096 support facts. Do not claim confirmed travel willingness, CxO events, ABM programs, field-marketing tenure, Marketo/Demandbase or regional pipeline results absent source.
spec.tools_rationale: Supported CRM, campaign and measurement tools for coordinated B2B execution without unverified field-marketing platforms.
